title: RHEL Server Patch with Preflight Checks
description: Patch a RHEL server by validating pre-patch memory, disk, and service state, applying all package updates, rebooting, and reporting post-patch status.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Hostname or IP address of the RHEL server to patch.

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of mount points to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem types to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: min_free_mem_mb
parameters.description: Minimum free memory required before and after patching.

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum free disk space required per filesystem before and after patching.

playbook_output.description: Emits per-step status, memory status, mount point status, and service comparison results.

fields.name: preflight_status
fields.description: Status of the pre-patch memory and disk checks.

fields.name: patch_status
fields.description: Status of the package update step.

fields.name: post_disk_status
fields.description: Post-patch mount point free space status.

fields.name: service_status
fields.description: Comparison of pre and post running services, including any mismatches.

steps.name: Gather pre-patch memory and filesystem facts
steps.function: Collect free memory and mount point facts before patching.

steps.name: Check pre-patch memory and disk space
steps.function: Branch on whether pre-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold or any non-excluded filesystem has insufficient free space.
steps.condition: Pre-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold OR any non-excluded filesystem has insufficient free space.

steps.name: Gather pre-patch running systemd service list
steps.function: Collect the list of running systemd services before patching.

steps.name: Update all packages
steps.function: Apply all available package updates to the server.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the server and wait for it to become reachable again.

steps.name: Gather post-patch memory and filesystem facts
steps.function: Collect free memory and mount point facts after patching.

steps.name: Gather post-patch running systemd service list
steps.function: Collect the list of running systemd services after patching.

steps.name: Compare pre and post service lists
steps.function: Compare the pre-patch and post-patch running service lists and compute the mismatch list.

computations._service_mismatch: List of services present in the pre-patch running list but absent from the post-patch running list, and vice versa.

steps.name: Check post-patch memory and disk space
steps.function: Branch on whether post-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold or any non-excluded filesystem has insufficient free space.
steps.condition: Post-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold OR any non-excluded filesystem has insufficient free space.

steps.name: Extract post-patch memory and disk status
steps.function: Extract post-patch free memory value and per-mount free-space status from the post-patch facts.

computations._post_memory_status: Post-patch free memory in MB from _post_facts.
computations._post_disk_status: Per-mount free-space status for each non-excluded filesystem from _post_facts.

steps.name: Build report with status
steps.function: Build the final report with memory, disk, and service status.

computations._report: Assemble the final report with memory/disk status and service comparison.

steps.name: Emit final report
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format result block containing per-step status, memory status, mount point status, and service comparison.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Collect pre-patch memory, disk, and service state and validate prerequisites before applying changes.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Apply package updates and reboot the server.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Collect post-patch state and compare services against the pre-patch baseline.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final report to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
